implementation_tests.caveat: The sharded test runner shares artifact registry state across workers. Run pytest sequentially for a single-process result; the fixture assertion failure is not a production MCP failure.

review_result: No material production-code blocker found. Updated stale Cloud/setup documentation and recorded the unscored comparison evidence before integration.
limits: The native runtime intentionally remains pinned before the beta release. Updating that revision requires new native references and verification.
Fresh checkout setup needs the retained source payload; ignored installed runtimes and caches are not committed.
The rehearsals do not establish a controlled model ranking, cost advantage, teaching acceptance or workshop readiness.
Users must learn from vignettes and lessons; scientific and Indonesian review remains required before classroom use.
